en.headline: Liantang Port records over 100 million passenger crossings in six years
en.dek: Shenzhen border authorities said the Heung Yuen Wai/Liantang checkpoint has handled more than 100 million inbound and outbound passenger trips and over 6 million vehicles since opening.
body: The Shenzhen General Station of Exit and Entry Frontier Inspection said on Sunday that the Liantang Border Inspection Station had cumulatively cleared more than 100 million inbound and outbound passenger trips and more than 6 million vehicle trips.

The Liantang/Heung Yuen Wai Control Point, which links Hong Kong’s New Territories with eastern Shenzhen, opened for cargo in August 2020 and for passengers in February 2023. Authorities said average daily passenger clearance has reached about 94,000 trips, with annual growth exceeding 37 per cent.

In the first 10 months of this year, Hong Kong and Macao residents accounted for more than 21.3 million of the trips through the port, up 12.7 per cent from the same period last year. The checkpoint has repeatedly set daily records and is operating well above its original design capacity.
Officials noted that the port serves as an eastern gateway for the Greater Bay Area, supporting tourism, commuting and other cross-boundary travel.

zh.headline: 蓮塘口岸開通六年累計出入境人次突破1億
zh.dek: 深圳出入境邊防檢查總站表示，蓮塘/香園圍口岸自開通以來已查驗超過1億人次及600萬架次車輛。
body: 深圳出入境邊防檢查總站日前公佈，蓮塘邊檢站累計查驗出入境人員超過1億人次、車輛超過600萬架次。
連接深港的蓮塘/香園圍口岸於2020年8月開通貨檢，2023年2月全面開通旅客檢查。當局指，日均出入境人員查驗量約1.4萬人次，年均增幅超過三成七。
今年首十個月，港澳居民出入境人次超過2130萬，較去年同期增長12.7%。口岸多次刷新單日紀錄，運作量遠超原設計容量。
當局表示，口岸作為粵港澳大灣區東部跨境門戶，支持旅遊、通勤等各類跨境活動。
